name: STAGGERED PUSH-UPS
introduce:
Start in the regular push-up position, but with one hand in front of the other. 

Then do a push-up and switch the other hand in front. 

Remember to keep your body straight.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Don't let your elbows point outward.
Do not sink or raise your hips.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
Too hard for you? Perform a traditional push-up.
